prices.status: superseded for the calculations by 'economics' (sourced parameters, October 2026); kept as the record of the first allowances

economics.note: parameters looked up on 2026-10-17 (web search; single listings and news reports of statistics, not quotations); each entry: low/nominal/high, unit, basis, source
economics.currency: EUR; USD listings converted at 0.92 EUR/USD (assumed rate)

source_capex_EUR.basis: no maker publishes a price; low = a used YLR-2000-SM listed at 19,999 USD (eBay, user-reported); nominal = 2 × a buyer's-guide estimate of 20–35 kUSD for a 1 kW IPG/Raycus module (mid, unverified); high = the reported original new price of a 2014 YLS-2000 (100 kUSD, laserresale, user-reported)

source_capex_per_kW_EUR.basis: the 2 kW range per kW, applied to the 3 kW source

head_EUR.basis: Raytools BF03S 3 kW wobble head 1,263 USD; Chinese 1.5–3 kW wobble heads 4,070–5,810 USD; Raytools BF06K 6 kW 5,122 USD (retail listings)

chiller_EUR.basis: S&A 2 kW chiller 1,259 USD; a 15 kW industrial chiller 4,200 USD; a 5 kW laser chiller sits between (no listing with a price found)

electricity_EUR_per_kWh.basis: Eurostat non-household 500–2000 MWh/yr, H2 2025: EU average 18.37, Finland 7.48, Ireland 25.52 EUR/100 kWh

labour_EUR_per_h.basis: Eurostat 2025 average hourly labour cost: EU 34.9, Bulgaria 12.0, Luxembourg 56.8 (economy-wide, not a welder's rate)

argon_EUR_per_m3.basis: US cylinder refills 40–60 USD per 125 cf (≈ 45–60 USD/m³); bulk is far cheaper (730 USD/t ≈ 1.3 USD/m³)

argon_flow_l_per_min.basis: shielding-gas flow of a sheet weld (assumed: welding practice)

maintenance_pct_of_capex_per_year.basis: assumed: no published figure found; the usual service-contract range for industrial lasers

diode_life_h.basis: passively cooled bars ~20,000 h to 80 % power; 9xx nm pump modules > 30,000 h median at 90 % confidence; 100,000 h is the makers' marketing claim

diode_share_of_capex.basis: assumed: the pump modules' share of a fibre laser's cost

steel_sheet_EUR_per_t.basis: NW Europe HRC 731 EUR/t EXW (SMM, Oct 2026); sheet cut to size carries 20–50 % over coil (assumed premium)

aluminium_sheet_EUR_per_kg.basis: assumed: LME ingot ~2.5 EUR/kg plus a rolled-sheet premium; no 5754 sheet listing found

black_pc_EUR_per_m2_per_mm.basis: assumed: standard black polycarbonate sheet ~40–80 EUR/m² at 5 mm; no listing found

certified_sheet_EUR_per_m2.basis: 1064 nm laser-safety acrylic sheet (OD 6+): 2,200–2,800 USD/m² from 12×12 in windows, 2,450–4,900 USD/m² per-sq-in pricing (retail; EN 12254-certified polycarbonate not found with a price)
